title: Capability Gap Tracker
question:
Find the page named "Analyst Portfolio" and create a comprehensive capability audit system while refreshing the featured projects section.
**Task Requirements:** 1. Create a new database named "Capability Development Tracker" as a child
   database in the main Analyst Portfolio page with the following
   properties:
   - Name (title property)
   - Current Capability (relation to Capabilities database)
   - Current Confidence (rollup from related capability's "Confidence"
     property)
   - Target Confidence (number property with format "percent")
   - Gap (formula: Target Confidence - Current Confidence)
   - Learning Resources (rich text property)
   - Progress Notes (rich text property)

2. Populate the Capability Development Tracker database with entries for
   all capabilities that have a confidence level below 70% (0.7):
   - For each qualifying capability, create an entry with:
     - Name: "[Capability Name] Development Plan"
     - Link to the corresponding capability in Capabilities database
     - Target Confidence: Set to Current + 25% (capped at 95%)
     - Learning Resources: "Practice projects and expert review"
     - Progress Notes: "Initial gap assessment complete"

3. Replace the usual focus callout with the following blocks immediately
   after the Projects database:
   - A divider block
   - A heading_2 block with text "Current Focus"
   - A paragraph block with content that dynamically references:
     - The highest confidence value from your Capabilities database (find
       the capability with the highest Confidence percentage)
     - Incorporate this into the text: "The Executive Metrics Workspace
       represents my most impactful recent work, leveraging my expertise in
       [highest capability name] ([confidence]%) to deliver
       executive-grade reporting that prioritizes both clarity and
       decision quality."
